notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, triggering Aetherstorm Roc and Blessed Sanctuary.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
The Unicorn enters the battlefield, triggering Aetherstorm Roc.
Resolve both Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.
